name: Spacewalker
bio: Six hours outside the airlock without a scratch. Six seconds down here and somebody's shooting.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-06 ("Astronaut", rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; thumb and middle finger chains only, so the fingers are re-fitted by hands.mjs; its two clips are not used). A white spacesuit with a gold visor and a backpack, in a T-pose; a 10.4k-triangle download, kept whole. Display name a placeholder for the owner.
